answer: Identities stop being free the moment each one must publish a verifiable unit of work. By the bridge of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. The design leans on time-locked work history, re-queued for a second panel, no identity may audit its own recruit. Each submission hangs on the vault of a task receipt, and the jetty is checked by a panel whose members never see the submitter. Written in a one long clause plus a short one register, it stays short.
